Upon signing and delivering the Service application by the Customer to any branch of the National Bank of Egypt (NBE)/to a service provider, these Terms and Conditions shall be deemed a final and binding agreement between the Bank and the Customer. Therefore, the Customer shall carefully and thoroughly read and understand the Terms and Conditions before signing.
I. Definitions:
Service(s): means the mobile payment service “PhoneCash”, subject of the Agreement, provided by NBE, under which a Mobile Account is opened for the Customer with NBE to make transactions including deposit, withdrawal, payment and/or electronic money transfer using mobile phone. The Account is opened credited with an electronic balance (electronic money units) in the amount credited by the Customer into his/her mobile account held with NBE or agents.
Bank: means the National Bank of Egypt (NBE) and all its branches.
Service provider: means any entity with which NBE enters into an agreement to provide some of the services related to offering executing the Service.
Customer: means any applicant/subscriber (natural person) to the Service contemplated hereunder, provided that s/he owns a mobile phone number and signs the Service subscription application. The Customer may not be less than 15 years old at the time of subscription the Service.
Mobile account: means the electronic mobile account opened with the Bank in the Customer's name, through which the Customer’s payments, deposits, withdrawals and transfers are made.
Electronic balance: means the credit balance of available electronic money units in the Mobile Account, based on the Customer's deposits into and withdrawals from his/her Mobile Account. The Electronic Balance is transferable to other customers and/or service providers. It can also be used as a means of payment to the entities announced by the Bank.
Electronic money units: mean NBE-issued electronic units of cash value, where each unit is equal to one Egyptian pound only, provided that the Bank receives, in return, an amount of money (in EGP) not less than the value of NBE-issued electronic money units which can be exchanged for money (EGP) at any time.
Territory: means the Arab Republic of Egypt (ARE).
Mobile phone: means any mobile phone compatible with any of the mobile networks operating in the Territory.
Activated mobile account: means the mobile account to which one transaction (i.e. withdrawal, deposit or transfer, including other debit transactions made from the account , and excluding balance inquiries and PIN change) is carried out over the last at least 90 days through any of the Bank's branches, payment service providers or available electronic channels.
Active mobile account: means the mobile account to which one transaction (i.e. withdrawal, deposit, transfer, or electronic or documented balance inquiry) is carried out over at least the last 12 months through any of the Bank's branches, communication means, available electronic channels or payment service providers.
Dormant mobile account: means a mobile account to which none of the following transactions has been carried out for one year: (withdrawal, deposit, transfer or electronic or documented balance inquiry).
Personal identification number (PIN): is a combination of secret digits used to authenticate the user's login to the system.
One-time password (OTP): is a password valid and used for authenticating a single login session or for a limited period of time to ensure that it will not be used in replay attacks if recorded by hackers. OTP may not be shared with anyone (e.g. passwords used for ATM withdrawals).
II. Service Provision Mechanism
Once the Customer signs the Service subscription application, subject to meeting the other Terms and Conditions and completing the mobile account opening procedures, and after verifying the Customer's identity by the Bank, the Bank will send an SMS to the Customer confirming that the Mobile Account is opened and containing a link to download the application. The Customer shall download the application from the mobile applications store, press “Activate service” and enter his/her name, mobile No. and national ID No. to confirm service wallet activation. The activation code, which may not be shared with anyone, will be automatically sent to activate the wallet . The Customer shall, upon logging into his/her mobile account for the first time, create his/her own PIN which shall be maintained by the Customer at his/her responsibility. The user should not use repeated digits or easily-guessed combinations of digits.
NBE reserves its right to review and accept/reject the Service subscription application submitted by the Customer, at any time during the Service validity period.
The Mobile Account shall be linked to a mobile phone line provided by a mobile network operator in the Territory. Such mobile phone line shall be in the actual possession of the Customer, and may not be linked to more than one mobile account.
The Customer shall be entitled to use his/her electronic balance through:
depositing or withdrawing money via service providers, NBE branches, banks participating in Service provision and/or electronic means provided by NBE/ participating banks in Service provision
transferring money from his/her electronic balance to other customers and/or service providers who may withdraw or credit such amounts to their electronic balances.
The Customer acknowledges that s/he knows that the electronic nature of the Service does not allow the operation of the Mobile Account using paper cheques, written payment orders or any other written instructions. Accordingly, the Customer may not request the Bank to issue a cheque book on his/her Mobile Account, or submit a written request to transfer balance from his/her Mobile Account to the account of any other person.
The Customer may use the electronic means available for providing the Service only for the Mobile Account and not for any of the Customer's other accounts held with the Bank, which are subject to the Bank’s applicable general banking regulations.
The Customer may, at any time, close the Mobile Account and redeem the cash equivalent to the Customer's electronic balance by signing the Service termination application at any of the Bank's branches or service providers. The Bank shall bear no liability in this regard and the Customer may not have recourse against the Bank with any claims once the Customer signs the Service termination application. The Bank shall close the Mobile Account within 3 banking days from the date of the Customer's Service termination application.
If the Customer wishes to re-subscribe to the Service, s/he shall visit the nearest NBE branch or use any of the available electronic channels.
III. Terms of Service usage
The Customer shall show and present to the service providers an acceptable ID upon carrying out withdrawals or deposits.
The Customer may not deposit any amounts into mobile accounts held in the name of other customers.
The customer hereby undertakes not to sell or assign their mobile phone line or e-wallet except through the official channels of the relevant mobile service provider and in strict adherence to its procedures. In the event that the customer violates this condition, the customer shall bear all risks and legal liabilities arising from the misuse of the e-wallet in financial crimes.
NBE may restrict, suspend or cancel the Service provided to the Customer if the Customer breaches any of the Terms and Conditions of Service, any applicable laws and regulations in the Territory or the Bank's applicable instructions including, but not limited to, purchasing any goods, commodities or services prohibited under the law applicable in the Territory or for any other reason at the Bank's sole discretion.
The Customer shall maintain and keep his/her PIN, at all times, under his/her personal control. Accordingly, the Customer shall be solely held liable for disclosing any data or information related to the Customer or any of the Customer's accounts if such disclosure is due to any error, omission or negligence by the Customer with respect to maintaining his/her PIN.
NBE’s customers holding any e-payment cards (i.e. credit, debit or prepaid cards) issued by NBE may replenish their Mobile Aaccounts from the balance of such cards.
The Customer who suspends the mobile phone line linked to his/her Mobile Account shall be disqualified due to breaching a key term of the Service. As a result, the Customer will automatically lose the right to use the Service via the suspended mobile phone line.
The Customer acknowledges that s/he shall be held liable for all transactions and instructions executed on his/her Mobile Account as long as such transactions and instructions are carried out through the mobile phone number linked to the Mobile Account and by using the Customer's PIN. The Customer further acknowledges that the Bank’s books and records shall be conclusive evidence against the Customer and any third party.
The Bank shall not be held liable for any losses or damage that the Customer may incur as a result of the Customer's misuse or abuse of the Service, any error committed by the Customer, malfunctioning in the Service due to a mistake on the part of the Customer, insufficient balance in the Customer's Mobile Account, or any other reason involving the Customer. Furthermore, the Bank shall not be held liable for any malfunctioning in the account systems or telecommunication networks related to the Service, provided that there is no breach or default on the part of the Bank.
The Customer acknowledges that the Bank shall not be liable for, nor bear, any costs or charges arising out of any interruption in the internet connection/mobile network or any other related disruption or breakdown in the same, provided that there is no breach or default on the part of the Bank.
The Bank shall neither be held liable for the refusal of any entity to accept the electronic balance as a means of payment nor for the goods or services received by the Customer in exchange for such balance. Any complaint by the Customer in this regard shall be resolved directly with the relevant entity. The Bank's role in that respect shall be limited to crediting any amount that may be recovered by the Customer to the Customer's Mobile Account, after the Bank obtains a credit note duly issued by the relevant entity.
The mobile phone SIM card received by the Customer shall remain the property of the mobile network operator. The Customer shall be fully responsible for maintaining the SIM card and for all the transactions carried out via the SIM card even if it is lost, stolen or used by a third party until the Customer notifies the mobile network operator in writing of the loss or theft. The Customer shall also notify the Bank of such loss or theft by calling NBE's Call Center at 19623 or visiting the nearest NBE branch.
If the Customer restores his/her mobile phone SIM card and wishes to reactivate the Service, s/he shall notify the Bank. The Customer shall re-download the application and enter the mobile phone number (linked to the wallet) and PIN. The activation code will be sent automatically so that the Customer can log in successfully.
The Customer undertakes that his/her mobile phone device used in making mobile payments is not and will not be rooted or jailbroken in the future.
All instructions given by the Customer to the Bank through the electronic means used in providing the Service shall be deemed to be directly given by the Customer, and shall be legally binding upon and enforceable against the Customer. Upon receiving and becoming aware of such instructions, the Bank shall promptly execute the same and take all the relevant procedures. Meanwhile, the Customer shall be held liable towards the Bank for all the consequences of executing the Customer’s instructions by the Bank.
If the Bank discovers any act or attempt by the Customer to breach or violate any relevant laws or regulations, the Bank may block all the Customer's electronic balances until the Customer gives a reasonable and acceptable justification to the Bank, without prejudice to the Bank’s right to take all the actions stipulated by the applicable laws in the Territory.
IV. Fees
The Customer undertakes to pay any Service-related fees including, but not limited to, Service registration fees (i.e. fees for opening the Mobile Account), annual fees, charges of withdrawal, deposit and transfer, and fees for any other relevant additional services, as per the applicable banking tariffs announced and disclosed by the Bank from time to time through the electronic means used to provide the Service or via the Bank's website "www.nbe.com.eg". The fees will be charged per transaction, plus the cost of forwarding connections by the mobile phone operator through its network, if any, either in the form of a phone call or an SMS.
The Bank reserves its right to amend any Service-related fees from time to time at its absolute discretion. Announcing the amendment of fees through the means deemed appropriate by the Bank, including the electronic means used to provide the Service, shall be deemed as an effective notice thereof to the Customer. The Customer's continued use of the Service after the amendment of fees shall be deemed an acceptance by the Customer of such amendment.
The Bank reserves its right to apply fees or charges to mobile accounts that have been dormant for one year with no financial transactions, if there is sufficient balance therein, provided that the Bank shall notify the Customer through the available communication channels on a monthly basis and for a period of three months before considering the account dormant. The Customer may activate the dormant Mobile Account through the Bank's branches, or any of the electronic means or communication channels provided by the Bank.
The Customer irrevocably undertakes to indemnify the Bank against all losses, claims, damages, costs and expenses, including legal, attorney and advisor fees, that the Bank may incur as a result of executing the Customer’s instructions or due to the Customer's breach of any provision hereof.
V. Miscellaneous
The Egyptian pound shall be the only currency used in rendering the Service.
Each mobile phone number shall be linked to one Mobile Account only. The Customer may not register more than three mobile phone numbers to use the Service at the level of all banks and telecom companies.
The Bank may assign a third party inside or outside the Territory to execute some of its obligations under the Service Terms and Conditions. In this case, the Bank shall remain liable towards the Customer for the confidentiality of all the Customer’s information and accounts, as well as for any error, negligence or omission committed by such third party.
The Bank, or any third party assigned to perform any of the Bank’s obligations under the Service Terms and Conditions, may record and keep phone calls incoming to customer service phone numbers.
The Bank may, at any time, terminate the Service provided that the Customer is notified by the means deemed appropriate by the Bank. The Bank shall meet its obligations towards the Customers, including exchanging the electronic money units for cash (in EGP).
The Bank reserves the right to amend or change any of the Service Terms and Conditions. Such amendment or change shall be effective and binding upon the Customer once the Customer is notified of the same by any means deemed appropriate by the Bank, including notifying the Customer electronically through any of the electronic means used in providing the Service. The Customer shall accept such amendments electronically in order to continue to use the Service. If the Customer does not accept any of such amendments or changes, s/he shall notify the Bank, no later than 30 days from being notified of such amendment or change, of its wish to terminate the Service. Further, the Customer shall forthwith refrain from carrying out any transactions through the Service, and request the Bank to close the Mobile Account(s) and make the necessary settlements, including the payment of any due amounts and redeeming any remaining balance owed to the Customer. The same termination procedures set out in paragraph (7) under Service Provision Mechanism shall be followed.
If the Customer wishes to change the mobile phone number linked to the Mobile Account, s/he shall promptly notify the Bank in order to link the existing Mobile Account to the new mobile phone number and take all the relevant measures.
If the Customer fails to activate the new Mobile Account or change wallet initial PIN within three months from the account opening date, the account will be closed.
The Bank shall have the right to close the Mobile Account one year after the account has been dormant, the account balance decreased to zero and the Customer failed to reactivate it, provided that the Customer shall be notified before closing the account through any of the available communication channels.
The Customer may activate his/her "dormant" Mobile Account through any of the Bank’s branches, payment service providers or available electronic and communication channels. Moreover, the Bank may close a “dormant” mobile account one year after the account balance decreased to zero and the Customer failed to reactivate it.
The Bank may debit fees or charges to a dormant Mobile Account if there is sufficient balance.
The Agreement shall be governed by the relevant Egyptian laws and their executive regulations, as well as the regulatory instructions and rules which govern the services provided by the Bank to the Customers via mobile phone. Cairo courts of different levels and instances shall have jurisdiction to resolve any dispute that may arise out of the interpretation or implementation hereof. Such disputes shall be resolved within the Arab Republic of Egypt.
Mobile Accounts may be opened for Customers who are Egyptian natural persons only.
The Customer shall carefully read any warnings or alerts such as security and fraud alerts.
The Service shall be available to Customers 24/7 all year round. The Bank shall inform the Customer in case the Service is disrupted for maintenance purposes. Any such issue shall be resolved within three banking days unless the Bank has to refer to a third party.
VI. Protecting customers' rights
National Bank of Egypt (NBE) is keen on applying the best international practices in the banking sector, and establishing clear rules and principles governing the relationship between the Bank and its Customers at all stages of transaction to meet the highest standards of fairness and transparency, comply with CBE's controls and protect customers’ data and rights in a manner that instills confidence between the Bank and its Customers based on obvious rules and principles. To this end, the following is agreed:
The Customer shall not offend the Bank, its employees, representatives, agents or correspondent banks or take any procedure or action that may harm the Bank or its reputation whether inside or outside the Bank’s premises and branches, via any electronic means or on social media, and shall use the channels made available to submit complaints. If the Customer violates this clause, the Bank shall have the right not only to close the account but also take all the necessary banking and legal procedures for protecting the Bank’s rights against the Customer.
Without prejudice to the Law of the Central Bank and Banking Sector on the confidentiality of customers' accounts and the AML/CFT Law and regulations, the Bank undertakes to protect the data and information of customers as all the financial and personal data and information of the Customer shall be confidential and may not be used or shared with third parties by the Bank without obtaining the Customer's prior written consent.
The Customer may check the maximum balance amount and the maximum value and number of daily and monthly transactions as well as the banking tariffs that apply to all banking products and services as regularly updated via the Bank's website:
www.nbe.com.eg
In case of the Customer’s failure, or delay, to meet any of his/her obligations and undertakings set forth in the Service Subscription Application, the Bank shall have the right to take the legal and banking actions necessary to preserve its rights.
All correspondence between the Bank and the Customer shall be in Arabic.
In case the Customer becomes aware of any transaction involving theft, embezzlement, manipulation or unauthorized transaction, the Customer shall promptly and without any delay notify the Bank and/or service provider.
In case the Customer becomes aware of any transaction involving theft, embezzlement, manipulation or unauthorized transaction, the Customer shall promptly notify NBE and/or Service Provider.
The Customer may submit to any NBE branch, or lodge the complaint via any other means made available or introduced by the Bank. The Bank shall reply to the complaint (in writing or electronically) within 15 business days from the date of receiving the complaint, except for complaints related to transactions with third parties (the Customer shall be notified of the period required to consider the complaint). In case the Customer rejects the Bank's reply, the Customer shall notify the Bank of the reasons for rejection in writing or electronically within 15 business days from the date of receiving the Bank’s reply. The failure of the Customer to do so shall be deemed an implicit acceptance of the Bank’s reply. In case the Bank is provided with the reasons for rejection, the complaint shall be reconsidered and the Customer shall be provided with the Bank’s final reply within 15 business days. The Customer may not escalate any complaint in relation hereto to the CBE directly, except in the following two cases:
The Bank's failure to reply to the complaint within 15 business days from the date of receiving the same
The Customer's rejection of the Bank's final reply to the compliant.
You can submit your complaint through any of the following channels:
Call Center at 19623 (locally) or +20219623 (internationally).
NBE's website:
Email: customer.service@nbe.com.eg
Social media: National Bank of Egypt
Fax: +202 5945221
The Customer shall carefully read and agree to all the Service Terms and Conditions and clearly and accurately understand the contents thereof.
The Customer is entitled to review the Service subscription application before concluding the agreement, and to obtain a copy thereof at any time thereafter.
VII. Information security requirements
When setting a PIN, avoid using personal information such as your birth date or part of your phone number.
Change your PIN regularly.
Keep your PIN confidential, and do not write it down anywhere or keep it on your mobile phone.
Use "PhoneCash" application on your mobile phone only. Avoid using public Wi-Fi networks; instead use trusted Wi-Fi networks to ensure a secure network connection.
Please note that NBE never asks you to provide your PIN, personal information, passwords or any personal details via e-mail, phone or SMS.
Protecting the PIN is your responsibility. Please do not share it with anyone in any way.
Change the PIN quickly and contact NBE's Call Center at 19623 if the PIN is suspected to be leaked.
One-time password (OTP) is used to secure financial transactions such as "Cash Out" transactions. Please do not share the OTP with anyone.

National Bank of Egypt - NBE Merchant Application
Definition of service:
NBE-Merchant Application for Payment Acceptance is a fast and secure way to track the transactions made by customers at the merchant using e-wallets, by scanning the QR code.
Service benefits:
Receive and review your payments and all details of your transactions in a safe and easy way through NBE-Merchant application.
NBE-merchant App Provide various payment methods for your customers.
The fastest way to check all current and past transactions through your application.
Receive instant notification when completing the payment process from your customer.
Use the app at any time through your mobile phone or through
"Unified Payment Gateway"
Registration process:
The merchant signs a contract to register on the QR code service.
NBE Merchant App is downloaded from the
Play store
The merchant receives a message with the activation code from the National Bank of Egypt on the mobile phone.
The bank creates and sends a QR code to the merchant.
In case of Static QR code, the merchant displays it in a clear place on the counter and in case of a dynamic QR code it is created through the POS or through the application so that the customer can scan the QR code and complete the process.

All Certificates are eligible, after one month following the purchase month, to enter six monthly drawings for twenty years unless redeemed by the Bank.

content:
National Bank of Egypt - Updates On Credit Cards International Utilization
Dear Valued Customer,
If you wish to use your credit card in foreign currency while traveling, please contact NBE Call Center or visit the nearest branch to request activation of international usage limits and notify NBE of the travel period.
Your credit card will be available for use according to the parameters of international usage of each card during the travel period.
NBE is entitled to request travel documents from its customers by sending an SMS, at any time, within 90 days (three months) from the date on which his/her credit card is activated for use abroad. Only a scanned copy of the passport (the page including the departure/arrival stamps to/from Egypt) should be sent to the email address:
CC-Operations@nbe.com.eg
,or the customer shall visit an NBE branch with the required documents, within a maximum period of 90 days (three months) from the date on which his/her credit card was made available for use during travel.
If the international usage limits are granted for a period of 90 days (the maximum period for limit availability), and the customer intends to stay abroad for a period exceeding this 90-day period, then it is no longer possible to obtain the entry stamp to Egypt on the date registered with the Bank, a proof of his/her continued presence abroad shall be emailed to
, or the customer shall visit an NBE branch with the required documents, to decide on the need for card suspension by the Bank.
Credit cards with international usage limits are made available to resident customers (immigration, business, etc.) after obtaining a copy of the residence permit to allow usage for one month during the year. After that, the card shall be used according to the established foreign-currency limits.
If travel documents are not sent within a maximum period of 90 days (three months) from the date on which your credit card is availed for abroad use upon the customer’s request to NBE, the Egyptian Credit Bureau (I-Score) to include the cardholder on the negative list upon notification from NBE . Moreover, the cardholder will be included in the list of customers who are denied credit cards and banking services in the future. In addition, the relevant authorities will be notified to take the necessary action.
Existing and new credit cardholders in Egypt and abroad who neither contacted the Call Center or visited the nearest branch, before or during the travel period, to request allowing limits, can use their credit cards in foreign currency according to the maximum daily/ monthly limit for purchases and/or cash withdrawal (or the equivalent in other foreign currencies) according to the local limits established in this regard. For more details, please
"Click Here"
Notes:
The limit of a single purchase transaction in foreign currency is the full credit card limit, in accordance with the respective parameters of each card.
If you hold more than one NBE credit card, the total monthly limit in foreign currency for all your credit cards is the monthly limit of the highest-limit card you hold.
Card limits in foreign currency are subject to the card’s credit limit or the relevant parameters, whichever is less.
The use of NBE cards has been suspended at select stores under certain categories.
The above parameters include a 3% markup fee in foreign currency.
All transactions carried out using the Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC) feature count within the limits of using cards in foreign currency. Consequently, markup fees will be applied to all such transactions.
Any newly issued NBE credit card will not be available for use in foreign currency for the first 60 days (two months) from the date of issuance.

content:
National Bank of Egypt - Escrow Account
The escrow account services
NBE offers escrow services to its existing or prospective (retail/corporate) customers for the purpose of managing financial, commercial, economic, or any other relationships that require intermediation between more than one party. The service is provided according to specific and clear terms agreed upon by two or more parties to carry out a transaction or deal — whether on a temporary basis or for a specified period or term. This is done pursuant to agreements concluded between the concerned parties and in the mutually agreed manner of selling or purchasing the assets. Escrow services also comprise commercial services, the settlement of existing and future outstanding amounts, and the management of assets and financial proceeds, etc. under an escrow account agreement signed by the concerned parties and the Bank. The escrow account is managed according to pre-determined terms and conditions as agreed upon between the agreement parties to ensure that any special requirements or conditions are met before transferring the financial value between the relevant parties. The Cheque Wallet web app could also be activated to enable customers to operate their various cheque wallets from business headquarters without any additional cost.
NBE Escrow Accounts Are Divided into Two Types:
One Transaction Deal Account
This account is opened (within 24 hours) according to a simple contract made between two parties to conduct one or more financial transactions, such as selling and purchasing vehicles or property. It is a pre-condition for one of both party to be an NBE customer or a banked customer in general.
Multi-Transaction Deal Account
This account is opened based on an agreement of specialized nature that can vary according to the nature of each transaction. The conclusion of such an agreement requires that a financial relationship exists between the concerned parties for a period during which intermediation is needed for handling their financial relationship, and this includes real estate development and participation agreements.
Financial Intermediation Transactions Include:
Asset (real estate - equipment - land - etc.) sale and purchase deals between two or more parties (individuals or institutions)
Share and stock sale and purchase deals for partners at all types of companies (joint stock companies - partnerships - limited liability companies)
Agreements on real estate development and distribution of proceeds among project partners
Real estate or tourism property management agreements between the owner and operator
Agreements on repayment of financial dues between creditors and obligors.
Advantages of using the escrow account service:
NBE has a highly competent team that is responsible for managing escrow accounts pursuant to the terms and conditions of the agreement made between the transaction parties and the Bank.
The Bank holds the obligation amount in the escrow account until the relevant conditions are met or the period specified in the agreement lapses. Interest may accrue on amounts in the escrow account.
Specified and agreed dates for the contractual obligations to be met are complied with. Funds are transferred to the beneficiaries as per each case through the Bank to ensure the collection of due amounts are streamlined and timely and that contractual obligations between the relevant parties are properly met.
A preferential credit interest may accrue.
Infinite number of escrow accounts may be created for a single transaction.
Escrow accounts can be in local and foreign currencies (USD, EUR, GBP).
The Cheque Wallet web app, which is linked to created escrow accounts, may be made available. It comprises the following benefits and features:
Any available post-dated cheques, which have not been previously delivered to NBE, can be delivered to the Bank. The delivery can be made in one batch or on a daily/weekly/etc. basis. Users may upload automated files of the same cheque details from the business headquarters.
The status of cheques in the account may be tracked online, to view whether they have been collected and dishonored, from the business headquarters through daily automated reports.
You may have access to a soft copy of a statement (in the form of a Microsoft Excel sheet) of the accounts linked to the Cheque Wallet web app to manage the transaction cash flows.
Escrow Account Team Responsibilities
Managing the purchase transactions of joint stock companies and limited partnerships.
Managing the real estate development project accounts with major real estate developers and governmental organizations.
Managing escrow accounts between the owners and operators of resorts and hotels.
Managing land and property sale transactions.

The Payroll Services:
Al Ahly Payroll is a service provided by the National Bank of Egypt (NBE) to companies and their staff. Salaries are transferred to NBE and staff are granted access to a bundle of NBE's retail banking services and products, including personal loans, auto loans, credit cards, deposits, certificates, etc.
NBE provides state-of-the-art, integrated and secured electronic systems for paying the salaries of companies' staff. There are two payroll programs tailored to meet all customers' needs, namely:
Al Ahly Payroll Card Program:
Through this program, a payroll card is issued for each employee, to which salary is transferred directly.
Al Ahly Payroll Current Account Program:
An integrated product is provided for companies/entities to transfer the salaries of their staff. Through such program, current accounts are opened with NBE's branches, and debit cards are issued for the staff to transfer their salaries.
Advantages of payroll programs for entities and staff:
Instant e-payment of salaries to all staff.
No congestion at the company/ entity during salary cashing periods.
Security for companies/ entities through limiting all risks in respect of handling large amounts of money.
SMS service for payroll card transactions.
E-banking services.
Customer Service Center round-the-clock.
Extensive network of ATMs and branches .

Appointment booking service
Service
The service enables all NBE or non-NBE customers to book an appointment through NBE's website.
The branches at which the booking service is available will appear to the customers when they attempt to book an appointment.
The service is free of charge and available 24/7.
Customers are allowed to book only one appointment across all NBE branches where this service is available, within official working hours.
Customers can amend the scheduled appointment date and/or time as well as cancel it if no longer needed.
The customer can amend the date of their scheduled appointment at any time before the actual timing of the appointment specified by them.
The timing of the appointment cannot be changed to another time on the same appointment day.
To check in, please show up at the branch at least one minute before the scheduled appointment and no later than 15 minutes.
The customer cannot book an appointment for the same day.
Steps for appointment booking through NBE's website:
Enter your national ID number and mobile phone number.
If you are an NBE customer:
enter your national ID number and mobile phone number registered with NBE. If you enter a national ID or mobile phone number that is not registered with NBE, you will not be able to proceed with appointment booking, and you will be directed to visit the branch to update your information.
Enter your e-mail address (optional), then click “Submit”.
Choose the department (Customer Service, Teller or Reception), or IBAG (only branches where the service is available will be shown), select the required service, then click “Submit”.
If your information must be updated, you will be directed to Information Update service only. Once you show up at the branch at the scheduled appointment, you will be transferred to any other department/service at the branch after you complete the procedures required for information update.
Choose the required NBE branch through one of the following methods
If you have agreed to sharing your location with NBE, you can select from the nearest 10 branches that will appear to you.
If you want to choose a specific branch or you do not want to share your location through NBE's website, you can choose the region, the area then the branch which you want to visit from the available branches in the region and area. (Note: You can type the branch name directly after selecting the region and area), then click “Submit”.
Choose the preferred day and time for your appointment, then click “Submit”.
Your scheduled appointment details will be displayed, including all the information entered in the previous steps (department, service, branch name, appointment number, date, and time). You can download the appointment details or amend/cancel the appointment.
When you arrive at the branch at your scheduled appointment time, you can check in using one of the following methods:
Scan the QR Code given with the booked appointment details to check-in and print your appointment details (only available at branches which have QR code readers).
Select the “Check-In” option on the kiosk screen, enter the mobile number, then your appointment time and required service will be displayed. Press the “Appointment” button to receive your appointment details and complete the check-in process.
Announcement
Branches located in clubs and sovereign entities are accessible to authorized persons only.
Please note that if your appointment falls on an official public holiday announced by the Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), it will be automatically canceled. Therefore, kindly schedule a new appointment on an official working day.
Islamic branches (Al-Azhar and Tahrir Islamic Branches) offer products of a special nature.

Booking an appointment with A SME business development specialist
The service aims to qualify existing and newly established projects and entrepreneurs in various economic activities to benefit from banking services such as credit solutions and technical consultations The service allows customers to book an appointment with a business development specialist (BDS) to hold a meeting through one of the following means:
Visit electronic service branches.
Book an appointment online through WebEx meeting.
Head to the nearest branch that has a Business Development Hub.
The service is available for all segments whether NBE or non-NBE customers.
There is no cost for requesting or obtaining the service.
Steps to book the appointment:
If you wish to visit the nearest branch to hold a meeting with the business development specialist, the following steps are taken:
Select your governorate.
Choose the nearest branch from the list of electronic service branches or branches with a business development hub.
Enter your national ID or passport No., then click "submit".
In case you wish to have consultations online, the following steps are taken:
Enter your national ID or passport No.
Click on "I would like to consult online without going to the branch", then click "submit".
After choosing the meeting method, fill in your personal information, then click "submit".
The request will be examined by the BDS and the appointment will be confirmed to obtain the service.
Terms and conditions:
The applicant may not be an NBE customer or owner/manager of the business to register.
No additional requests are received, in the event of a pending request.
In case of choosing to "facilitate access to finance", the BDS completes the necessary documentation to consider the facility in accordance with the applicable business procedures and then direct the customer's request to the customer's nearest credit unit to contact him/ her and take the necessary actions towards examining the finance request.
If a customer is to miss a scheduled appointment, the BDS must be notified sufficiently in advance thereof by telephone (one business day).
If a customer arrives late at the branch after the appointed time, a request is registered and a new appointment is scheduled.
If a customer needs an explanation/data/papers, the customer is directly referred, during a conversation, to the Customer Service Officer with no intervention by the electronic services branch.
The branch providing electronic services is not responsible for receiving/completing any customer's data at the branch premises.

Our Strategic Sustainability Framework: EESG
NBE’s sustainability efforts are not newly born. Being the biggest Bank nationally and regionally; NBE’s foundational nature, performance and impact extends beyond traditional commercial banking and profit making.
In 2018, NBE embarked on a voyage for aligning Bank Strategic Pillars with Egypt Vision 2030 (updated September 2019); as well as the UN Sustainable Development Goals 2030.
Our strategic framework embraced Value Creation through: Economic, Environmental, Social and Governance pillars. Our approach contributed to surfacing hidden sustainability thematic areas and highlighting our strategic contribution to global economic transitions – from cashless to digital, from exclusion to inclusion, from banking to green banking, and from corporate social responsibility to strategic social development.
